title: Truss analysis from input axis lines
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) analysis of a triangulated truss built from axis lines. Use for planar or near planar trusses where members carry mostly axial force. The template shatters input lines at their crossings (Karamba Line-Line Intersection), so members meet at shared nodes even when drawn as continuous chords. Assumptions: lines in metres, one steel section for all members, self weight active, ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN applied as a vertical point load at EVERY model node, supports pinned at ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS (the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes when the caller does not). Members are modelled as beams, not ideal pin-ended bars, so some bending stiffness remains. Limits: no buckling verification of slender compression members; no joint design; no per-element utilization output, so the validator's strength check falls back to deflection and the L/250 limit. HARNESSED 2026-08-29 from 01_InputCurvesAsTruss.ghx (the input-curves Karamba example, not the slider-parametric one).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Truss member axis lines, node-merged at shared endpoints.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN
inputs.description: Vertical point load in kN applied at every model node (drives the template's Unit-Z force vector).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted, the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically, mirroring the api pathway's convention.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba's Analyse emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
